known_limitations: Sentiment coverage is limited to 3,769 of 87,550 catalog movies.
Movies without sentiment use neutral sentiment score 0.5.
Unknown users do not currently have collaborative embeddings.
CF-mapped movies without trained embedding support are excluded.
Offline Top-K metrics use sampled ranking with 1,000 negative candidates per user, not full-catalog ranking.
CF+Content core underperformed CF-only in the sampled offline ranking evaluation, while the final hybrid outperformed both.
